title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Are you a proactive, hands-on recruiter who enjoys finding great people, building relationships and keeping recruitment moving?

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join a busy, collaborative recruitment team at an established legal organisation based in Birmingham. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and commercially minded recruiter who thrives in a varied environment and takes pride in delivering a positive candidate experience.

Salary is up to £45,000 depending on experience and benefits include hybrid working, 33 days holiday including Bank Holidays and free car parking.

You will be working across a diverse range of operational and professional support roles, you'll take ownership of vacancies from initial briefing through to offer, partnering with hiring managers to identify the right talent and deliver effective recruitment outcomes.

As the Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will:
- Manage end-to-end recruitment: Take ownership of vacancies from briefing and advertising through to screening, interviews, offers and placement.
- Attract great talent: Write engaging job adverts and use appropriate recruitment channels to generate quality applications.
- Engage candidates: Proactively contact applicants, assess suitability and maintain communication throughout the recruitment journey.
- Partner with hiring managers: Build effective working relationships, understand recruitment requirements and provide practical advice and regular updates.
- Coordinate the process: Arrange interviews, manage feedback, support offers and ensure smooth pre-employment handovers.
- Keep things organised: Maintain accurate candidate and vacancy records, recruitment system updates, documentation and reports.
- Deliver a great experience: Ensure candidates receive timely, professional communication at every stage, including when they are unsuccessful.
- You'll recruit across a broad range of vacancies in operations and professional support

As the Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will have:
- Previous recruitment experience, gained in an in-house team or recruitment agency.
- Experience recruiting across varied, operational, professional or high-volume vacancies.
- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to build rapport with candidates over the telephone and in writing.
- Strong organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple vacancies and competing deadlines without losing momentum.
- A proactive, resourceful approach, with the confidence to investigate issues and find solutions independently.
- Flexibility and resilience when priorities change in a fast-paced environment.
- A collaborative working style, combined with the ability to work autonomously and take responsibility for results.
- Experience using an applicant tracking system (ATS), which is essential.
- Good general IT skills, including email, calendars, document preparation and reporting.
- You'll be comfortable balancing the people-focused side of recruitment with the administrative detail required to keep processes accurate, efficient and compliant.

If you're an enthusiastic recruiter who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and making recruitment happen, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Contract Compliance Officer
description:
Since 1899, Birmingham Settlement has been working to create opportunity and choice - connecting and empowering people through action, activities, and shared learning to build and sustain wellbeing for all.

Contract Compliance Officer

Salary: £26,000 pa (dependent on experience, for review following successful completion of probation)

35 hours per week

Based at Birmingham Settlement's Sports & Community Centre, Kingstanding, Birmingham

This is a fantastic opportunity for a highly-skilled, experienced and motivated Administrator to work for our established and highly respected Advice Quality Standard (AQS) accredited Money Advice Service.

As Contract Compliance Officer you will undertake administrative duties to collate data and support the production of service reporting for the Settlement's commissioned Money Advice Services - including the provision of information for Birmingham City Council and the Money and Pensions Service (MaPS).

You will work with the Money Advice Service Manager and Debt & Welfare Benefit Advisors to provide administrative support as required, including receiving and making calls to clients. This will sometimes include helping out with reception duties as required.

The role forms an integral part of the Money Advice Team.

You will be joining a long established and professional Money Advice Service providing specialist advice with a holistic approach that covers all areas of debt and welfare benefit along with financial literacy training to build and continually improve money management and financial capability.

Our Money Advice Team sits within the overall Settlement which provides a wide range of community support services covering all ages and aspects of need, please see our website.

This is a great opportunity to join a progressive charity making a real difference to people's lives.

For an informal discussion about the role call Theresa Gniadkowski.

This is an active recruitment; early applications are encouraged

We reserve the right to close this opportunity early if a successful candidate is appointed prior to the closing date

Why Work for Birmingham Settlement?

At Birmingham Settlement, you're not just taking on a job, you're becoming part of a friendly, values-led organisation that has been making a difference across Birmingham for more than 125 years.

We're proud of our diverse, supportive and collaborative culture. Our teams work closely together across advice, wellbeing, community development, environmental and training services, creating opportunities to learn from one another, share ideas and develop professionally. No two days are ever the same, and you'll have the chance to see first-hand the positive impact your work has on individuals, families and communities.

We recognise that our people are our greatest asset and are committed to creating a workplace where staff feel valued, supported and able to thrive. We offer flexible working arrangements, encourage positive work-life balance, invest in learning and development, and promote wellbeing through a range of staff activities and social opportunities.

Our benefits include:
- 28 days annual leave , increasing with length of service to a maximum of 33 days
- Contributory pension scheme
- Flexible working options
- Free use of our community gym
- Free onsite parking at all of our sites
- Staff wellbeing activities and social events
- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
- The opportunity to work within a passionate organisation committed to creating opportunity, reducing inequality and building stronger communities

If you're looking for a rewarding role, where you provide essential support an excellent team and make a genuine difference to people's lives, we'd love to hear from you.

inclusive of 3 days annual leave between Christmas and New Year

Please submit your CV with Supporting Statement of no more than 1,000 words to address how you will meet the requirements of the role, please also submit your Equality & Diversity Form you can find it on our web page and email it to us or write to Human Resources, Birmingham Settlement Sports & Community Centre,

600 Kingstanding Road, Kingstanding, Birmingham, B44 9 SH

Closing date for applications: Tuesday 10th November 2026

Interviews: To be confirmed

Birmingham Settlement is committed to Equality of Opportunity and welcomes applications from all sections of the community. Registered charity number 517303
